content.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: final portrait slot cabinet background for a mobile game. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is only a control-layout clarity reference; do not copy its cabinet shape, colors, title, reels, ornaments or symbols. Modify only the lower physical control-deck area of Image 1, approximately source pixels y=1010 to y=1280. Keep the coin crown, title marquee, jackpot display, 5x3 reel window, black credits readout, twin coin towers, lower body, outer silhouette, camera, scale, lighting and all geometry outside that deck unchanged with maximum fidelity. Rebuild the champagne-gold and emerald control deck as a visibly taller, softly sloped two-tier physical console integrated between the coin towers. Exactly seven blank functional button faces, no extra buttons: upper primary row has TURBO face near x=272 y=1112, one dominant circular SPIN face near x=512 y=1120, AUTO face near x=752 y=1112; lower utility row has two wide metal faces near x=288 and x=424 y=1224 for paytable and rules, plus two smaller separated round faces near x=640 and x=736 y=1224 for bet minus and bet plus. Make upper faces about 100x78 pixels, spin about 120 pixels diameter, utility faces about 120x54 pixels, small bet faces about 58x54 pixels. Button caps must be blank and dark enough for runtime icons and labels, with real recessed sockets, engraved gold rims, subtle emerald status jewels, soft edge light and distinct spacing. Preserve the warm coin waterfall, ruby and emerald high-roller luxury; festive and lavish, not solemn. Do not add readable text, labels, UI overlays, extra reels, logos, watermark, duplicate controls or floating buttons. Output one complete 1024x1536 image.
